policy: Exactly one game per review cycle, selected only after explicit quality signoff. This is the Morrow Wish studio policy, not a statement of a published CrazyGames universal platform limit.

candidates.risk: Many systems and new art; must validate full loop, controls, pacing, visuals and crashes with cold players.
User reported a rejected CrazyGames submission. Earlier stealth/iframe fixes are not sufficient evidence of compelling play.
Original concept but win/loss pacing, clarity, depth, and multiple meaningful strategies need validation.
Narrative, text load and replay value must fit short-session browser players.
One-click controls are accessible, but generic endless-runner mechanics need a distinct hook and satisfying progression.
Simple color-lane sorting may lack mastery, variety and replay incentives.
One-minute matching challenge may lack enough depth and meaningful choices.
